questions.q: In a certain code language, 'GOOD' is written as '75' and 'FINE' is written as '82'. How will 'BEST be written in that language?
questions.s:
The positional value table is as follows:

The pattern followed here is:

Coded word = (Sum of opposite positional values) + 8

  • In GOOD → 75 
    • Sum of opposite positional values = 20 + 12 + 12 + 23 = 67
    • Coded word = 67 + 8 = 75

 

  • In FINE → 82 ​
    • Sum of opposite positional values = 21 + 18 + 13 + 22 = 74
    • Coded word = 74 + 8 = 82

 

  • Similarly, In BEST → ​
    • Sum of opposite positional values = 25 + 22 + 8 + 7 = 62
    • Coded word = 62+ 8 = 70

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

questions_hin.q_hi: If " PATNA " is written as " ANTAP ", how is " RAJASTHAN " written?
questions_hin.s_hi:
PATNA reversed letter-by-letter = ANTAP.

Apply the same to RAJASTHAN (9 letters): reverse → N-A-H-T-S-A-J-A-R.

Code = NAHTSAJAR.

questions_hin.q_hi: 12. एक निश्चित कूट भाषा में, "TIME" को "43" लिखा जाता है, और "WHEN" को "46" लिखा जाता है। उसी कूट भाषा में ‘TURN" को कैसे लिखा जाएगा ?
In a certain code language, 'GOOD' is written as '75' and 'FINE' is written as '82'. How will 'BEST be written in that language?
questions_hin.s_hi:
The positional value table is as follows:

The pattern followed here is:

Coded word = (Sum of opposite positional values) + 8

  • In GOOD → 75 
    • Sum of opposite positional values = 20 + 12 + 12 + 23 = 67
    • Coded word = 67 + 8 = 75

 

  • In FINE → 82 ​
    • Sum of opposite positional values = 21 + 18 + 13 + 22 = 74
    • Coded word = 74 + 8 = 82

 

  • Similarly, In BEST → ​
    • Sum of opposite positional values = 25 + 22 + 8 + 7 = 62
    • Coded word = 62+ 8 = 70

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
